latHint: Think a grand house with a long driveway and a butler.
pivHint: Solomon says to commit whatever you do to the LORD. In medieval times, a LORD who owned an estate lived in its large house, called the ______.
winText: You found it. LORD isn't just the one we commit our plans to. A medieval LORD was a nobleman who lived in a MANOR.
lossText: The word was MANOR. LORD was the pivot. In medieval times, a LORD was a nobleman who owned land, and he lived in the large house on his estate, called the MANOR.
votdVerse: Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
passageText: To humans belong the plans of the heart, but from the Lord comes the proper answer of the tongue. All a person’s ways seem pure to them, but motives are weighed by the Lord. Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
